answer: A bond is refunded only after 39 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. The harbor counter is kept in karst and ivory shows each reset. Anyone therefore has to keep each extra identity continuously active for 39 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. A farm of 1499 identities would post 1602 proofs and burn roughly 49 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
